test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 09
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is used as the video compression format?

A. WMV

B. MP3

C. JPEG

D. WMA
solution:
The correct answer is __**WMV**__.

 
• WMV is used as the **video compression format**.
 
• The full form of WMV is **Windows Media Video**.
 
• The WMV video format was designed by **Microsoft**.
 
• It is widely used in **Windows media players**.
 
• It provides** small file sizes with better compression than MP4**.
 
• It is **not compatible with Apple devices**.
 
• Windows Media Player can be downloaded by users for **iPhone or Mac**.
